# Appropriation Ordinance No. 02, Series of 2020

**Resolution No. 057, Series of 2020**

**Supplemental Budget No. 2** — Authorizing supplemental budget from various funding sources totaling **P16,532,967.42**.

## Summary

Enacted on June 22, 2020, this supplemental appropriation ordinance authorizes the use of multiple funding sources to supplement the annual budget of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] for CY 2020. The ordinance consolidates savings and surplus funds from various accounts to address operational and development needs of the municipality.

### Funding Sources

| Source | Amount |
|--------|--------|
| Savings/Surplus as of December 31, 2019 | P12,608,525.04 |
| Personal Services CY 2020 | P533,446.38 |
| Savings MOOE CY 2020 | P150,000.00 |
| 20% Development Fund Savings | P900,000.00 |
| Unappropriated Balance, Annual Budget CY 2020 | P1,740,994.38 |
| **Total** | **P16,532,967.42** |

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** Authorization of the supplemental budget in the total amount of P16,532,967.42.
- **Section 2.** Savings/Surplus as of December 31, 2019 in the amount of P12,608,525.04 is appropriated for specified programs, projects, and activities.
- **Section 3.** Personal Services savings for CY 2020 amounting to P533,446.38 is realigned for priority expenditures.
- **Section 4.** MOOE savings for CY 2020 amounting to P150,000.00 is appropriated for operational needs.
- **Section 5.** 20% Development Fund savings of P900,000.00 is allocated for development projects.
- **Section 6.** Unappropriated balance from the Annual Budget CY 2020 amounting to P1,740,994.38 is appropriated for identified priorities.
- **Section 7.** The Municipal Treasurer and Municipal Budget Officer are authorized to release and certify the availability of funds.
- **Effectivity.** Takes effect upon approval.
